designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized Klondike Gold Rush National Historical Park, made up of a Seattle unit in the Pioneer Square Historic District and three units in Alaska.
designationHistory.note: The act let the Secretary pick and later relocate the Seattle unit's site within Pioneer Square by Federal Register notice; those siting notices are not listed.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Washington, Seattle entry), 'Authorized June 30, 1976'
